name: E2E dogfood 527: reads a linked error reference
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'my agent keeps getting a 429 from OpenAI, what does https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/error-codes say that code means and what should i do about it'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy reads the linked page and answers what the error code means, rather than declining the request as out of scope.
The answer names where it came from.
Langy does not treat a link the user pasted as something it is not allowed to open.

parameters.name: world
parameters.description: Which matrix world the setup hook builds
